title: Minimum Time To Revert Word To Initial State I
description:
You are given a string `word` and integer `k`. Each second, remove the first `k` characters and append any `k` characters. Return the minimum positive number of seconds after which `word` can equal its initial value again.

## Examples

```text
Input: word = "abacaba", k = 3
Output: 2
```

```text
Input: word = "abcbabcd", k = 2
Output: 4
```

## Constraints

- `1 <= word.length <= 50`
- `1 <= k <= word.length`
- `word` contains lowercase English letters.
